headline: Every Economic Data Point | Top 10 first-tier city property projects sold over 200 billion yuan combined in the first 9 months, Shanghai widens its lead
summary: The ten leading property projects in China's first-tier cities sold over 200 billion yuan combined in the first nine months. Shanghai widened its lead among the cities.
why: Property sales are a key indicator of China's housing market, which carries large weight in the country's economy and in developer credit risk.
